title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: transition
text:
transition
transition
(definition)
Definition:
The change from one
state
to another in a
finite state machine
.  Analogously, an
edge
in a
directed graph
.
Also known as
state transition, move.
See also
transition function
,
next state
,
Mealy machine
.
